Text Reverser

Reverse text by characters, words, lines, or reverse each line individually.

Text Reverser

Reverse text by characters, words or lines.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste your text into the input box.
  2. Choose a mode: characters, words, lines, or each line reversed.
  3. Click "Reverse text".
  4. Copy or download the result.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What do the four modes do?

Characters flips the whole string ("abc" → "cba"). Words keeps each word intact but reverses their order. Lines reverses line order; "each line" reverses the characters inside every line.

Does it handle emoji correctly?

Yes — it uses Array.from, which splits text into full Unicode characters, so emoji and accented letters stay intact instead of breaking into halves.

Is my text uploaded anywhere?

No. Reversing happens entirely in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
